verdict.rationale: As a SQL database, ClickHouse handles bulk work as set-based operations: docs cover bulk and asynchronous insert strategies, INSERT SELECT is parallelized by default, and community users report ingesting billions of rows per day. One community report notes limited DELETE support, so bulk modification is weaker than bulk ingestion. Missing for 10: documented bulk update/delete mutations, evidence of bulk operations driven through the AI-facing interfaces (MCP/CLI).
